notes.title: Patch 5.1
notes.content:
If you are interested in keeping up to date with more information you can join the discord I have setup. https://discord.gg/Tw2cF9w.  

This list does not include all the changes to the game.  I have not kept track of all the subtle changes but here are most of the ones that matter.

UI -  A complete overhaul of many of the UI elements.

Armor Class -  Resists still exist but will be used for magic spell defense.  Armor class will now determine all melee damage mitigation.  It also affects combat speed and magic effectiveness.

Travel Mode -  This is the default mode you play the game in.  It will let you run at normal speed regardless of what armor you wear.  Pressing Tab will toggle between Combat and Travel modes.

Combat Mode -  In this mode you can cast spells, use melee abilities and use your basic attack.  Your armor class and speed of your weapon will affect how fast you move in this mode.  

New Basic Attack -  Instead of waiting to attack with a basic swing based on the weapon's attack delay, you now can spam left mouse click and keep attacking doing full damage each time.  Your swing speed is determined by the weapon speed and your armor class.

Regeneration Changes -  Stat regeneration now only happens when you sit or have armor, skills, or food buffs that have it.  While you still can kill things pretty effectively without it by using potions or bandages, having some passive regeneration from food increases your ability to sustain active combat and minimize downtime between enemies.

NPC System -  NPCs now have a specific day night cycle.  They will go to store, fish, farm, etc.  They also will turn off the torches at their house, lock their door, and sleep at night.  At the end of a cycle they will drop off whatever they have earned during their day into a chest they own.  I wonder if you can steal from it?  

Fishing -  A completely new fishing mode has been created.  This new mini-game makes fishing a little more fun then the previous one.  New UI and a smoother experience all around.

Mining and Logging -  These two methods are more traditional.  You just need the proper tool and find a node.  The nodes now have several different locations they can spawn so they won't always appear where you think.  

Crafting Changes -  New crafting system has been updated for everything.  You can now craft almost all the armors and all the weapons.  Several potions, foods, etc.  There are several crafting perks for each skill which I will let the player discover.  These in the long run can make your crafting skills very powerful in certain areas.

-  Changed how wildlife spawns to free up network and increase performance.  Before the wildlife would spawn when game started but now they work like other enemy spawns.  Once you enter the dedicated area, the wildlife will spawn and remove itself when you leave.
-  NPCs are removed from network and now each player has their own NPCs walking around.  You wont be able to see other players NPCs if playing with them.
-  Lots of optimization changes.
-  Removed weapon delay and changed it to speed.  This now affects combat mode speed instead.
-  Major update with loot across the board.  More items and more variation but also making it harder to obtain weapons and armor.
-  Updated character speed slightly.
-  Mana Regeneration now saves properly on food.
-  Fixed Yellow Perch Lake Trout fish information.
-  Fixed Azure Shards information.
-  Fixed Southern Tovanian Crab information.
-  Updated all of the town buildings LODs for better performance.
-  Fixed door height for town buildings and took them off the network.  For now you will see other players go through doors because you won't see them open on your client.  This was done to save network bandwidth.
-  Added food that provides Stamina Regeneration.
-  Updated the skill sheet UI with the new artistic design.
-  Updated skills list to show proper bonuses and also removed a few attributes that weren't being used anymore.
-  Updated the fishing dock and added a new fishing system.
-  Rebuilt all the buildings in the town again.  Did a lot of work in blender to update my skills.
-  Updated textures across the board.  They are higher resolution so most things in the game will be better detailed.
-  Built several new crafting stations like the leatherworking stations, cooking station, and forge.
-  Added more prefix and suffixes to weapons and armor.
-  Added rarity to normal items.  Now you will see the rarity difference from loot that are not weapons or armor.  Undead essence will have a green border for example.
-  Updated the rarity names as well.  Basic, Common, Uncommon, Rare, Legendary, Fabled, Mythical, Artifact.
-  Decorated a lot of the town and some of the interior of buildings.
-  Priest will now heal you free of charge.
-  Updated quest journal.
-  Mining is now changed with randomized nodes around the town.
-  Added more crafting recipes and perks.
-  Updated the cemetery to make it more interesting.
-  Removed the bow from the game for the time being.
-  Updated the interaction UI.
-  Changed hot bar background image.
-  Updated the bank and church so they are more distinguishable from the other buildings.
-  Fixed character weight and slope navigation.  It should be much harder to go up steeper cliffs.
-  Fixed town building null zones.  Most buildings you enter should soften the outside weather and fog as well as weather audio.
-  Updated several sounds.
-  Fixed the ability to stack potions and food that didn't have the same stats.
-  Fixed problem not being able to put stamina potions on the hot bar slot.
-  Revamped the entire NPC movement system.
-  Updated the City Guard movement and response to criminals.
-  Added doors to most buildings.
-  Fixed target UI sometimes showing the wrong name.
-  Created a few new house designs.
-  Updated all enemies' properties.
-  Revamped fishing.
-  Updated the wolf particle location so when procs occur it doesn't bug the game.
-  Updated a few items that didn't have correct stats when dropped.
-  Willpower affects regeneration timers.
-  Quests have been revamped.
-  Crafting has been revamped.
-  Removed several trees in the forest area but increased the overall size of foliage.
-  Changed some of the skills that you can get and the rest are coming soon.
-  Updated Bandit Camp.
-  Updated Lizard Temple.
-  Removed several spawns temporarily.
-  Added new housing items.

There is much more that has happened but failed to keep track of it all.  There are also some things I don't wish to reveal and let the player discover.

notes.title: Patch 4.8
notes.content:
If you are interested in keeping up to date with more information you can join the discord I have setup.  https://discord.gg/Tw2cF9w.  Sometimes I won't write patch notes for weeks but the discord I am very active.

Here is a summary of what is in this patch.

-  Database wipe.  Your characters will remain but your save will be wiped.  Due to massive changes and not having a wipe for months, I felt it was time to reset.  If possible I would reinstall the game as well.

-  Updated skills.  Skills now are stronger and some have more utility.  This should make for ways to make more unique characters.

-  Skill reset now costs 250 gold. 

-  New buff effects and most should show up on the buff bar as well.

-  Updated game models to utilize more "bones".  This will make clothing and armor not clip as much through the body.

-  New input system.  You can now change WASD movement.

-  Added a couple new skills.

-  Added a few new items.

-  Added NPCs again in town.  They will now talk sometimes as well.  Very buggy on multiplayer servers but works great on private server.  Will be working on this and looking for a fix asap.

-  You can now place house property anywhere that is flat enough and far enough from certain objects.  You can buy a property deed at the blacksmith and houses from the woodworker.  You also get a house recall that will work every 5 minutes.

-  Lowered thunder sound and slowed weather transitions to be more seamless.

-  Major weapon balance changes.  This should provide more incentive to use daggers or one hand axes.  

-  Several bosses added to random camps that will spawn after killing a certain amount of enemies.

-  Added 20 new minor artifacts that can drop from bosses.

-  Added a few new procs for weapons and armor and increased drop chance.

-  Lots more updates over the last couple weeks.  

-  Lots of minor bug fixes per usual.

notes.title: Patch 4.2
notes.content:
There has been a lack of patch notes because I am lazy.  If you are interested in keeping up to date with more information you can join the discord I have setup.  https://discord.gg/Tw2cF9w

Here is a summary of what has been going on for the last few patches.

-  Major monster revamp.  Lots of new variations of monsters have been added.  With the new variations the difficulty has been spread out so it is easier to progress.  Several new areas to kill mobs all around the world.

-  Item, weapon, and armor drops have been reworked.  Monsters will now slowly drop more valuable items as they become harder to kill.  On top of weapons and armor getting better already as you progress, I have adding in another element to give these items a chance to be even more potent as you level.

-  You cannot build your own house anymore.  It just wasn't working out the way I wanted.  You can now select your plot marker and buy a house from the menu there.  There are three options at the moment but soon to be many more.

-  Lots of housing items have been added to all the monsters in the world.  As you kill harder monsters you have a better chance of getting a house item.

-  NPCs walking around town have been removed temporarily.

-  Another major crafting change.  Back to a trial and error style crafting.  Lots of materials in the game will gives bonuses to crafting.  Lots to discover.

-  Harvesting has been changed slightly.  There are certain areas now where you can farm ore and are pretty obvious.  There are multiple different ores as well.  Tree leaf color has been changed to yellow to help increase visibility.  Skill level and luck (separate from luck on weapons and armor) will now give you a chance for more loot from harvesting.

-  Lots of new items added to the game for crafting or other reasons.

-  When monsters attack previously, they would shoot out an invisible "bullet" at about the point when the weapon would contact the player.  You used to be able to dodge this.  Due to some issues with monsters not being able to hit you at certain distances, this was removed.  You are now invulnerable when dodging and timing a monster attack to dodge at the right time is how to dodge now.  There are still some errors when you can be hit outside monster range.  Basically if an enemy gets in attack range and starts attack you cannot run out of the way only dodge, block, or hope they roll a miss.  

-  New quests for the hunter.  You will now kill mobs through this hunter for quests and it will slowly unlock new areas like bosses or temples.  For now it is basic kill and receive gold.  There will be new quests for others such as the cook who will provide recipes on how to prepare certain meals when you complete his quests.

Lots of other things but I just didn't write them down.  Balance changes, minor bugs, multiplayer fixes, etc.  

Thanks and see ya soon!

notes.title: Patch 4.1
notes.content:
-  Hovering over skills in the skills list ("L") will now provide more accurate information about that skill.
-  You can now craft a bank chest that you can place on your property.  This chest shares the bank you have in town.
-  The Athletics skill now improves stamina efficiency.  
-  Added a few new property locations all updated with new prices.  The further away from town you go the cheaper the property.
-  You can now only own one property and you can release your property to buy a different property but you will not be refunded.
-  Enemies will only have an animated "Hit" response to being damaged if they are not attacking.  This is intended to get rid of the queued" Hit" response you sometimes see when attacking enemies.
-  New beginning tutorial that will lead you through some of the basics of the game.
-  Fixed pristine raw spider meat showing up as a white box in the loot.
-  Major skills update.  All the abilities and skills have been updated and there are several new attacks and abilities.  
-  Added a roof to the inn.
-  Removed charisma and short blades.  Daggers are now under the long blades category.  Soon to be just blades.
-  Runestones can now be marked and then used to teleport around the map.  One time mark and one time use per runestone.
-  Fixed being able to use certain items from the bank.
-  Blacksmithing weapons now gives a damage and durability bonus based on skill level.
-  NPCs have been added to town again and now are synced up between players.  Sometimes they can get a little buggy but usually get back to normal.
-  Made the bank UI bigger.
-  Entering the houses in the town will now lower wind, rain, and ambient sounds to make it seem indoors.
-  Fixed issue with lowering criminal status and messing up weight.
-  Fixed guards still attacking after criminal status is lowered.  Still buggy in open world.
-  Guards will now respond quicker after being hit.
-  Lots more fixes and changes that didn't make the notes.

notes.title: Patch 4.0

-  Huge backend code update regarding armors and how they look on the player.  Added new armors.
-  Added bank limit to the bank.
-  Lots more I forgot to write down for the last month :)!

-  Updated several magic skills and weapon skills to have better balance.
-  Updated Lizard area buildings.
-  Lots of bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 3.7
notes.content:
-  Added all new prefixes and suffixes to weapons which will provide a lot more random combinations.
-  Added lots of new icons for weapons and they will now save.  Rings still don't save.
-  Increased weapon damage across the board.
-  Added more decor to the cemetery.
-  Updated quests so they should be functioning correctly.  Updated the quest Becket has in the church.  If you already had this quest it might cause a problem and you wont be able to start from beginning.
-  Updated journal to include main quest name and quest currently on.
-  Fixed chat locking up occasionally.
-  Added repair icons that pop up when items you are wearing get low on durability.
-  Decreased skill gain slightly.
-  Fixed enemies getting stuck on edge of their movement radius.
-  Lots of bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 3.6
notes.content:
-  Fixed Divine Gift in the Holy Skill Tree not providing luck.
-  Fixed Mana Regeneration buffs.
-  Luck buffs now properly add luck and influence drops.
-  Fixed the white item bug. (I think)
-  Fixed not being able to purchase a house and after not being able to place objects.  Was a weird issue between the editor and client where the client would not act the same way as the editor.  Had to do with the client on the plot marker looking for the player before they were in the game.  The editor didn't seem to mind oddly.
-  Wisdom now increases healing more.
-  Added skill gain chance for all spells.  Here comes the macros!
-  Added healing amount from some spells in log.
-  Fixed issue when playing on someone's server where you can't cast buffs or certain spells.
-  Fixed spells proc chance to properly proc at right amount.
-  Fixed being able to keep using abilities after you remove them from hotbar.
-  Changed several spells.

notes.title: Patch 3.5
notes.content:
Player wipes don't need to happen anymore based on code upgrades.  I will only wipe on official release or possibly if the game is broken. 

-  Housing has been upgraded to make it easier to use.  You can now use mouse to move things around as well as the arrow keys for precision placement.  More items that can be placed in your house have been added to certain enemy loot.
-  New crafting system.  Currently, only the cooking station has it implemented.  The system is based around discovery of crafting recipes by trial and error and/or finding recipes in the world.  Once you find a recipe it will unlock a picture of it on the UI cooking station.  You then can just click that to cook the same recipe again without having to drag and drop items into the cooking slot.  
-  Several enemies have had their health increased to create more difficult mobs to kill.
-  Added procs to weapon drops.  Rare to find.
-  Added the first dungeon back into the game which is a temple in the desert.  In there you can find difficult mummies and a hidden boss.  Temple is very small at the moment but will be expanded on in the future.
-  There is now a bonus to luck at night.  This will reward players that venture into darkness to kill enemies.
-  You can repair weapons and armor now for gold.  Weapons and armor can only be repaired three times before they are too brittle.
-  Vendors will not sell housing items anymore, you need to craft them.
-  Fixed Vampiric Strike and Respite in the blades tree.
-  Fixed Tree Ent loot.
-  Split items now get the correct info.
-  You can't chat with inventory open anymore.  This is mainly for bugs and hopefully I will have a new way to deal with this in the future.
-  Lots of bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 3.4
notes.content:
-  Dynamic monster spawning:   Monsters will now only spawn when someone is close to their camp.  This will cut down on the amount on monsters active in the game world at any given time and will improve performance. 
-  Monster balance:  Lizardmen, Undead Mages, Mummies, Trolls, and Tree Ents, have had their health drastically reduced and other stats have been shifted slightly.
-  Fixed several issues with certain skills not working.
-  Fixed another bank bug being able to keep it open.
-  Replaced some more assets with my own.
-  Added blocking without a shield but it is not nearly as effective.
-  Added NPCs in that will walk around the town.
-  Added in more detail to the UI when hovering over weapons and armor.
-  Added in a Skill Reset button.
-  Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 3.3
notes.content:
Skipped posting a couple patches because I got lazy.  You will have to make a NEW CHARACTER for this patch due to upgrades in the code which will break your game.

-  Harvesting got an overhaul.  When harvesting using WASD to influence the mini game along with the mouse buttons. 
-  Lots of monster updates with damage, health, reaction time, etc.
-  Hair will now be hidden when putting on a helmet.  There is a problem when loading the game still if you have hair and a helmet on.  You just have to reequip to fix.
-  Fixed Axe skill update to say "Axe" instead of "Axes".
-  Added repairs to weapons and armor,
-  Fixed weapon and armor values not saving.
-  Watcher now drops items.
-  Added housing back into the game.  Very basic and buggy.
-  Lots of minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 3.2
notes.content:
-  Added sounds to doors.
-  Housing updates with more options.
-  Added in a couple very rare house items that can drop off enemies.
-  Fixed open mouth NPC issues and updated several of the models.
-  Most NPC eyes look correct.
-  Updated some of the quests.  Most should be working.
-  Fixed quests to give you the correct loot on completion.
-  Lowered blacksmith quest from 20 to 10 ore requirement.
-  Fixed some mobs spamming utility spells resulting in stacked buffs.
-  Updated a lot of potions to be able to craft them while also increasing potency on some.
-  Fixed Surge spell in Water Magic.
-  Added crafting and harvesting to skill list so you can see progress.
-  You can only fish at certain "Fishing Spots" now.
-  Added a chance for reagents to drop on most enemies.
-  Updated crafting quite a bit with new requirements and other fixes.
-  Added a few new catalysts for crafting.
-  Adjusted heavy fog.
-  Updated the UI for purchasable items besides weapons and armor.
-  Music now plays more randomized.
-  Guards have been toned down but are still very difficult to kill.
-  Added a small church outside of town that allows you to pay off criminal status, use a bank, and buy food.
-  Harpy enemy has been added to the game.
-  Lots of minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 3.1
notes.content:
-  Fixed where the pop up text when skilling up displays.  It should work on all monitor resolutions now.
-  Added more variation on some of the enemy's attacks and movements.  
-  Fixed issue when shooting bow the player would become stuck and unable to move.
-  Fixed arrows so you cannot eat them anymore.
-  Fixed several items that also had sustenance.
-  Added multiple enemies back into the game and adjusted their stats.
-  Removed signs that were in the middle of no where.
-  Optimized more items.
-  Enemies that cast spells will now occasionally cast them when they are in melee range.
-  Fixed buff particle location for some of the enemies.
-  Added a few new abilities for certain enemies.
-  Disable overland map for a new map coming soon.

notes.title: Patch 3.0
notes.content:
This patch will include both 2.9 and 3.0.  There have been many patches but they all don't get an update.  I didn't keep track of all the updates very well this time around but future patches will have more info.

-  New terrain has been created to replace the old world.
-  Added player hit sounds.
-  New items and monsters added.
-  Fixed mining quest bug that would take ore but not set weight properly.
-  Lots of backend refactoring for items.
-  Adjusted fog.
-  Improved performance.
-  Balanced item drops from enemies.
-  Added bandages.
-  Working a lot in blender to provide my own assets.  A small portion of assets are now mine.
-  Added a pop up when you increase skills.
-  Lots of bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.8
notes.content:
This patch also includes some other information from previous patches that was not listed.

-  Changed the decimal places for damage taken and inflicted to two.  (eg 4.56 instead of 4.566)
-  Added an auto save that will trigger every five minutes.
-  Fixed losing attacking rating twice on death based on weapon's attack rating resulting in going under the default 750 mark sometimes.
-  Added a new start screen and the option to play on a private server.
-  Added dynamic music based on whether you are in combat or not and in certain areas.
-  Fixed ranged enemies LOD.
-  Fixed mandrake in store so now you can use it to craft.
-  You no longer can drop housing pieces anywhere.
-  Fixed most issues with buffs and any self target spells.
-  Major refactor in backend to increase speed for creating items.
-  Added more items and now enemies have different loot tables.
-  Lots of bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.7
notes.content:
There was a long period between patches due to learning Blender and learning optimization techniques to improve performance.

-  Lots of optimizations to almost everything in the game.  LODs, occlusions, etc.  
-  Most buildings in game have been replaced with my own objects I created instead of Unity store assets.  ( Still use a lot of those all through the game but working towards eliminating most)
-  Added NPCs that wander the town and will stop at certain spots to perform actions.  Spent a decent amount of time learning to rig and properly import into Unity from Blender.  Had to get fbx from current model and lower its polygon count to help increase performance.
-  Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.6
notes.content:
-  There are four plots of land at the moment with varying prices and you can buy building pieces at the forestry merchant.
-  There are little stones on the property you can click on using interact button and you can buy the property from there.
-  Once you own a property you can drag house items from inventory bag to other part of screen to "drop" the item into the real world.  You can only build inside your area as the green will designate.
-  Use the arrow keys to move the items around and right click and hold to rotate.
-  Make sure you deactivate the item by interacting with it.
-  You can pick up the item by interacting with it then right click right shift it.
-  Major bug - other people can purchase same property as you can build there as well resulting in both people having decorations on the same property.  Soon to be fixed.
-  Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.5
notes.content:
-  Complete dungeon revamp.  Lots of new ways to explore the dungeon and it gets harder as you get deeper.  There are a couple of mini bosses and an end boss if you can make it!
-  Item drop changes across the board.  Lowered quite a bit to give incentive to kill harder things.
-  Fixed pristine spider meat loot.
-  Ruins only spawn low tier enemies now.
-  Removed several trolls.
-  More optimization with lighting.
-  Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.4
notes.content:
-  Added food buffs when you eat food you have cooked.
-  Yellow Perch now a common fishing item.
-  Guards will now attack monsters.
-  An interact pop up shows up now when hovering over interactable objects.
-  You can loot with the interact key now, default "F".
-  Fixed wildlife loot issue with non-master client players.
-  Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.3
notes.content:
-  Enemies can now block and move around you when fighting.  Should add a little more fun to combat.
-  Changed enemies attack delay to make them not stand around so much during combat.
-  Fixed "coins" drop from Goblins.
-  Magic spells from enemies and players should be seen across clients.

-  Chat works again but you can't scroll to see old messages.
-  Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.2
notes.content:
-  Player Loot Drop.  You will drop all the loot on you including equipped items on death.  Those items will be places in a bag where you died.  Only you can pick it up for the time being due to some issues.
-  Fixed goblins loot not working correctly.
-  Fixed goblins not spawning a goblin again after killing it,
-  New spells and effects for tier one and two 
-  Added new stats to the stat sheet and changed its appearance.
-  Equipped items should now randomly lose durability when hit.  Percent chance that one item will lose durability when you take damage.
-  Added some walls around the town and a few more guards.
-  Updated the criminal outpost so the NPC's work.
-  Added several more wolves in the area.
-  Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.content:
-  Major skills additions.  Almost all skill trees are full except physique and arcane.
-  New types of skills added like Mana Shield, stuns, roots, etc.
-  Buffs now provide an icon under your stat bar that you can highlight for time remaining currently.

-  Fixed potions.
-  Fixed fireball smoke trail not showing smoke but default white box graphic.

-  Lots of bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:

-  Lowered player resistance effectiveness.

-  Minor bug fixes.

-  Fixed weapons not being able to equip after losing a two-handed axe.

-  Moved sun location to better position representing June-July so its more over the top.  Also turned off day rotation so the sun never changes its arc position.
-  Chat now works normally as you would expect.
-  Upped max weight to 150.

notes.title: Patch 1.6

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
-  Added regeneration to monsters.  If you are outside their range they will start to regenerate.
-  Fixed Troll Meat weighing only .01.  It now weights 4.2.
-  Fixed being able to equip a bow while having a torch or shield equipped.
-  Add criminal status to target the the right of their name.
-  You can now attack players without penalty that have a criminal status of three or more.

-  Decreased arrow price.
-  Fixed mummy move radius.

-  Fix Air Element icon showing wrong element icon.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
-  Fixed Greater Health Potion icon when crafting and loading game.
-  Added new artifacts to the game.
-  Added several new armor variants so you can look a little different from others.
-  Fixed issue with hotbar being locked after using an ability with the wrong weapon equipped.
-  Fixed gouge and hamstring to work on players.
-  You no longer can equip an off-hand with a two-handed axe.
-  Fixed loot from digging.
-  Criminal system added.  Anytime you attack a player or guard you will gain a count in criminal rating.
At 3 counts you will become a criminal and guards will attack you.  If you die as a criminal you will be spawned at a different location.  The temple NPC provides a way to lessen you criminal rating for a fee.
There is also an NPC at the criminal camp that will do the same for a higher price.
-  Guards added.
-  Criminal camp added.
-  Fixed heal self taking mana twice.
-  Updated the stat/skill screen with new icons and more polished.
-  Lowered skill rate and gains.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:

-  Implemented rock harvesting.  Purchasing a Pick Axe then clicking on it while aimed at a reddish rock will start the process.

-  Fixed buffs locking toolbar.
